_comment: Reference only. This file is NOT read by any container and contains no
credentials. It documents the shape of the SeaweedFS S3 identity file that
the seaweedfs service generates at start-up from .env into
/etc/seaweedfs/s3.json (the seaweedfs_config named volume). The generator is
the entrypoint in docker-compose.yml; change it there, not here.
